Name: Joah, Son of Joahaz
Summary: Joah, son of Joahaz the recorder, was sent by Josiah with Shaphan and Maaseiah to repair the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Josiah sent Shaphan, Maaseiah the governor, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Joahaz, Father of Joah
LifeLesson: A recorder's name is kept in the repair of the temple.
